key_points: Q3 sales beat (+4.9% to $43.4B) but comparable sales growth driven by ticket size not traffic (transactions -0.5%)
New CEO Richard McPhail appointed in leadership reshuffle
Stock fell 2.5-3% post-earnings on margin pressure and tepid forward outlook
Analysts split: Truist/Bernstein raised targets on share gains; JPMorgan/Goldman cut on leverage/margin concerns
Long-term positives: exclusive product ecosystem locking customers, dividend resilience amid housing headwinds
